main.display_name: アンケート NPS 集計
main.name: nps-survey-aggregate

params.sql: SELECT COUNT("推奨度") AS responses, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST("推奨度" AS INTEGER) >= 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS promoters, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST("推奨度" AS INTEGER) <= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS detractors, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN CAST("推奨度" AS INTEGER) >= 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN CAST("推奨度" AS INTEGER) <= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / COUNT("推奨度"), 0) AS nps FROM data WHERE "推奨度" IS NOT NULL
